description: The Server and Capella AWR pages differ by six hunks, all link targets and API names - yet AWR is new in Couchbase Server 8.0 (stated on server/current/introduction/whats-new.md and the release notes) and the Capella page states no version at all. A Capella reader whose cluster was built from a pre-8.0 Server base has no way to tell from this page whether AWR is available to them.
